# drmsh.com

> > The official website of Dr. Michael S. Heiser, biblical scholar and Semitic languages expert specializing in divine council theology, ancient astronaut theory critique, and Second Temple Judaism.

Dr. Heiser's platform provides academic biblical scholarship, debunking of pseudoarchaeology (particularly Zecharia Sitchin's ancient astronaut theories), and resources on UFOlogy from a biblical perspective. The site hosts a membership community with exclusive content, mobile apps, and livestream Q&A sessions.

## Key Topics

- Dr. Michael S. Heiser
- Divine Council Theology
- Biblical Scholarship
- Zecharia Sitchin Critique
- Ancient Astronaut Theory Debunking
- Nephilim
- Anunnaki Research
- Sumerian & Akkadian Texts
- Nibiru Debunking
- UFOlogy & Biblical Theology
- The Facade (novel)
- DrMSH Community
- Semitic Languages
- Second Temple Judaism
- ETCSL (Electronic Text Corpus of Sumerian Literature)
